description: This file defines the API and data structures for handling temporary files, including creation, deletion, renaming, and management of temporary files and directories. It includes function prototypes, inline functions, and documentation comments.

methods.name: create_tempfile_mode
methods.description: Creates a temporary file at a specified path with given mode.

methods.name: create_tempfile
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with default mode 0666.

methods.name: register_tempfile
methods.description: Registers an existing file as a tempfile to be deleted on program exit.

methods.name: mks_tempfile_sm
methods.description: Creates and opens a temporary file with a filename derived from a template, with options for suffix and mode.

methods.name: mks_tempfile_s
methods.description: Inline wrapper for mks_tempfile_sm with suffix length.

methods.name: mks_tempfile_m
methods.description: Inline wrapper for mks_tempfile_sm with mode.

methods.name: mks_tempfile
methods.description: Inline wrapper for mks_tempfile_sm with default mode.

methods.name: mks_tempfile_tsm
methods.description: Creates and opens a temporary file with a filename derived from a template, suffix, and mode.

methods.name: mks_tempfile_ts
methods.description: Inline wrapper for mks_tempfile_tsm with suffix length.

methods.name: mks_tempfile_tm
methods.description: Inline wrapper for mks_tempfile_tsm with mode.

methods.name: mks_tempfile_t
methods.description: Inline wrapper for mks_tempfile_tsm with default mode.

methods.name: xmks_tempfile_m
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with a filename derived from a template and mode, dies on error.

methods.name: xmks_tempfile
methods.description: Inline wrapper for xmks_tempfile_m with default mode.

methods.name: mks_tempfile_dt
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory and file within it, returns a tempfile.

methods.name: fdopen_tempfile
methods.description: Associates a stdio stream with an open tempfile.

methods.name: is_tempfile_active
methods.description: Checks if a tempfile object is active.

methods.name: get_tempfile_path
methods.description: Returns the path of the tempfile.

methods.name: get_tempfile_fd
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor of the tempfile.

methods.name: get_tempfile_fp
methods.description: Returns the FILE pointer of the tempfile.

methods.name: close_tempfile_gently
methods.description: Closes the tempfile's file descriptor and FILE pointer without deleting the file.

methods.name: reopen_tempfile
methods.description: Reopens a tempfile that was closed with close_tempfile_gently.

methods.name: delete_tempfile
methods.description: Deletes the tempfile, closing its descriptors.

methods.name: rename_tempfile
methods.description: Atomically renames the tempfile to a specified path.
